name: Alien Video Game Store
author: ProdigiousMike
description: Explore the alien video game store! Toggle between 10 cameras with the "c" key, or use a numbered key 0-9. Alternatively, and for mobile users, you can use the on-screen GUI for camera & sound control. My contributions include: Shaders: The alien box on the counter uses a custom-scripted shader that dynamically moves, glows, & changes opacity. Lighting: Neon lights decorate the walls & shelves, brightening the scene & attracting attention to various wares. Animation: Upon entering the store, you are greeted by the cashier, who waves & bows, while alien customers wander & examine different games. VFX: Make a wish! Peek out the window to see shooting stars, but watch your head, as steam may come out of pipes & vents. Cameras: The scene contains 10 views to appreciate the entire scene. Post-processing: Colorful, bright, vibrant filter. Audio: Muzak blares from the speakers as machines droll & aliens communicate in squeaky speech. UI: A fun, futuristic UI panel to control camera & sound.
